# rediscloud_iris_agent_memory_type (Resource)

Manages a custom memory type. Description and fields are immutable within a store. Destroy disables extraction before unregistering the type, permanently retiring its name in that store. Use a new name for a different schema. Extraction can be updated only if a strategy was configured when the type was created.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "rediscloud_iris_agent_memory_type" "example" {
  store_id           = rediscloud_iris_agent_memory.example.id
  name               = "preferences"
  description        = "User preferences"
  extraction_prompt  = "Extract the user's preferences."
  extraction_enabled = true
  field {
    name        = "topic"
    description = "Preference topic"
    type        = "STRING"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) Human-readable description of what this memory type captures.
- `name` (String) Unique type name within the store. Must not collide with built-in types
(semantic, episodic, message, session_summary, session_summary_view).
- `store_id` (String) Identifier of the parent memory store.

### Optional

- `extraction_enabled` (Boolean) Whether extraction is active. Defaults to true when a prompt is supplied.
- `extraction_prompt` (String) Prompt for extracting memories of this type.
- `field` (Block Set) Structured fields of this memory type. Immutable after creation. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--field))
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Memory-type identifier in the form `<store_id>/<name>`, also used for import.
- `revision` (String) Opaque revision returned on reads. Server assigned; ignored on creation.

<a id="nestedblock--field"></a>
### Nested Schema for `field`

Required:

- `description` (String) Description of the field.
- `name` (String) Field name.
- `type` (String) Value type.


<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import rediscloud_iris_agent_memory_type.example st_11111111111111111111111111111111/preferences
```
